events.action: Jonas severs the relay cable by hand to stop it guiding ships onto the mis-charted reef.
events.cost: he becomes the man who let the station go silent, and can never say why on the record

preconditions: mara opens the panel to file a routine fault
events.action: Mara opens the relay housing and finds the cable was cut clean, and the cut is old.
events.cost: she can no longer file an honest fault without indicting a predecessor she never met

events.action: Pressed, Jonas gives Mara the reason obliquely: the chart is wrong; the relay was drowning the ships it called.
events.cost: he passes her the weight he has carried alone
